        AND SUM(COLUMN_NAME='end')>0
        AND SUM(COLUMN_NAME='strand')>0

SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(
    CONCAT(
        'SELECT ''',
        REPLACE(TABLE_NAME, 'seq', ''),
        ''' AS dataset,
        gene_id,
        dna
        FROM `',
        TABLE_NAME,
        '`
        WHERE gene_id = ''OsN22_01G017170'''
    )
    SEPARATOR ' UNION ALL '
)
INTO @seq_sql
FROM (
    SELECT TABLE_NAME
    FROM information_schema.COLUMNS
    WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE()
    GROUP BY TABLE_NAME
    HAVING
        SUM(COLUMN_NAME='gene_id')>0
        AND SUM(COLUMN_NAME='dna')>0

'SELECT
    g.gene,
    g.chromosome,
    g.start,
    g.end,
    g.strand,
    s.dna
FROM
(
',
@gene_sql,
'
) AS g
JOIN
(
',
@seq_sql,
'
